Local sanitizer/runtime note:
- The repository includes libFuzzer/AFL++ targets, ClusterFuzzLite workflows, and sanitizer build plumbing for address/undefined/memory modes.
- In this container, executing ASan-instrumented binaries fails even for a trivial standalone C program, which points to an environment/runtime issue rather than a repo-specific crash.
- Functional validation completed here used the normal test suite, the libpng differential harness, and the local CI wrapper.
